prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but first I need a bit more so my recommendation is useful. Quick questions:

- When did the accident happen? (This matters for deadlines.)
- Where exactly in Pleasanton did it occur and was there a police report?
- What injuries did you sustain and are you still getting treatment?
- Do you know who was at fault and what the insurance situation is (your insurer, the other driver’s insurer, uninsured/underinsured)?
- Are you looking for a lawyer who will take the case to trial if needed, or just negotiate a settlement?
- Any other preferences (language, budget concerns, mobility/meeting needs)?

Why I ask: statute of limitations and insurance deadlines can be strict (in most California personal-injury cases you have 2 years to file suit; claims against public entities have much shorter windows), and the right lawyer depends on injury severity, fault complexity, whether government/entity is involved, and whether you want trial experience.

How to choose the right Pleasanton / Alameda County personal-injury lawyer
- Focus: hire an attorney who primarily handles auto/PI cases (not a generalist).
- Experience: look for someone with recent experience and trial experience in similar cases (soft-tissue vs. catastrophic injury vs. spinal/brain injury).
- Track record: ask for examples of settlements/verdicts for cases like yours.
- Communication: clear point of contact, regular updates, prompt return of calls/messages.
- Fees: most injury lawyers work on contingency (commonly ~33% if settled before suit; higher if suit/filed or appealed). Confirm who pays costs, and what happens if you lose.
- Who actually works the case: ensure a lawyer (not only paralegals) handles core tasks; ask who will attend depositions/trials.
- Local knowledge: a lawyer familiar with Alameda County courts, judges, and local experts can help.
- Comfort and trust: you should feel comfortable and that they understand your priorities.

Key interview questions to ask during a free consult
- How many years have you handled car/PI cases? What percentage of your practice is this?
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?
- Who will work on my file day-to-day?
- What is your fee structure and who pays litigation costs?
- Will you advance medical liens and out-of-pocket costs?
- What is a realistic range of value for my case and estimated timeline?
- How will you communicate with me and how often?
- Can you provide references from former clients?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar amount or “100% win.”
- No written fee agreement or unclear costs/expenses.
- Pressure to accept a quick low settlement without investigation.
- Poor communication during the initial consult.

Immediate steps you should take now
- Get/continue medical treatment and keep records and bills.
- Preserve evidence: photos, police report number, witnesses’ names/contacts, video if available.
- Don’t post details on social media about the accident/injuries.
- Report the accident to your insurer as required.
- Save all paperwork and medical records.
- If public entity involved (school bus, city vehicle), ask about immediate notice claims — those have shorter deadlines.

If you want, I can:
- Compile a short list (3–6) of well-reviewed personal-injury lawyers and firms near Pleasanton/Alameda County and note what each is best-known for.
- Or evaluate 2–3 attorneys you’re considering if you paste their names/links.

Tell me the details above or say “please find attorneys near me” and I’ll prepare a tailored shortlist and what to ask each in a consult.
